title: resourceRequest
responsibility: Resolves explicit or automatic CPU and memory requests against live headroom or an inherited parent reservation.

inputs.name: resourceRequest.flags
inputs.description: Resources CLI priority, CPU, RAM and label fields, including supported auto sizing.

inputs.name: resourceRequest.service
inputs.description: Queue access, current telemetry and configuration directory used to resolve automatic requests.

inputs.name: resourceRequest.env
inputs.description: Resource and caller environment used to resolve paths or bounded worker settings; unrelated credentials are not newly propagated.

outputs.name: resourceRequest
outputs.description: Validated concrete request preserving parent limits for nested automatic sizing.
